令

$$
a = | a | \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \varphi_ {a}}, \quad b = | b | \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \varphi_ {b}},

$$

所以

$$
\langle S _ {x} \rangle = \hbar \operatorname {R e} (a b ^ {*}) = \hbar | a | | b | \cos \theta , \quad \langle S _ {y} \rangle = - \hbar \operatorname {I m} (a b ^ {*}) = - \hbar | a | | b | \sin \theta .
$$

$$
\sigma_ {S _ {x}} ^ {2} = \left\langle S _ {x} ^ {2} \right\rangle - \left\langle S _ {x} \right\rangle^ {2} = \frac {1}{4} \hbar^ {2} - \hbar^ {2} \left| a \right| ^ {2} \left| b \right| ^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta .

$$
\sigma_ {S _ {y}} ^ {2} = \left\langle S _ {y} ^ {2} \right\rangle - \left\langle S _ {y} \right\rangle^ {2} = \frac {1}{4} \hbar^ {2} - \hbar^ {2} | a | ^ {2} | b | ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \theta .

$$

$$

其中 $J$ 为正的常数.相互作用使得近邻自旋按照相反方向排列(即反铁磁，如果它们是磁偶极子)，但是三角形排列意味着这三对自旋并不能同时满足该条件(图 4.8).这就是几何"阻挫"

$$

该情况下，基态是唯一的.证明:哈密顿量可以写为

$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} H = J \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {1} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {S} _ {2} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {3} + \boldsymbol {S} _ {3} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {4} + \boldsymbol {S} _ {4} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {1}\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2} J \left(S ^ {2} - S _ {1} ^ {2} - S _ {2} ^ {2} - S _ {3} ^ {2}\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

由于

$$
S _ {i} ^ {2} = S _ {i} \left(S _ {i} + 1\right) \hbar^ {2} = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {1}{2} + 1\right) \hbar^ {2} = \frac {3}{4} \hbar^ {2},
$$

所以

$$
H = \frac {1}{2} J \left(S ^ {2} - 3 \frac {3}{4} \hbar^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} J \left(S ^ {2} - \frac {9}{4} \hbar^ {2}\right).
$$
